changeSet.author: Víctor Cañizares

preConditions.onFailMessage: Cannot convert blacklisted_token.expiration and revoked_at to TIMESTAMPTZ: they are not both TIMESTAMP without time zone. Inspect them with: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'blacklisted_token' AND column_name IN ('expiration', 'revoked_at');
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'blacklisted_token' AND column_name IN ('expiration', 'revoked_at') AND data_type = 'timestamp without time zone'

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE blacklisted_token ALTER COLUMN expiration TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING expiration AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', ALTER COLUMN revoked_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING revoked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE blacklisted_token ALTER COLUMN expiration TYPE TIMESTAMP USING expiration AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', ALTER COLUMN revoked_at TYPE TIMESTAMP USING revoked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
COMMENT ON COLUMN blacklisted_token.expiration IS NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN blacklisted_token.revoked_at IS NULL
